inj_report.short: Gibbs carried the ball 21 times for 205 yards and three touchdowns while catching all five of his targets for 47 yards in Thursday's 39-35 loss to the Bears.
inj_report.long: The superstar running back was already headed for a career-best season coming into Week 12, but Gibbs took things to another level on Thanksgiving, producing his third career game with three rushing scores and his second with 200-plus rushing yards. The 252 scrimmage yards also tied his season high, a mark he reached just two weeks ago against the Patriots. Gibbs leads the NFL with 1,754 scrimmage yards, and given his current form he could reach 2,000 as soon as next week, on the road against the Falcons.

inj_report.short: Burrow completed 28 of 40 passes for 300 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions and rushed twice for minus-1 yard in the Bengals' 22-20 loss to the Commanders on Monday night.
inj_report.long: The Bengals offense started slowly and was shut out altogether in the first quarter, but Burrow was able to lead his team to 10 second-quarter points partly via a 31-yard touchdown pass to Tee Higgins. The prolific signal-caller added a four-yard scoring toss to Colbie Young in the third quarter, and Burrow then helped lead Cincinnati downfield for a go-ahead Evan McPherson 56-yard field goal with 46 seconds remaining, albeit after narrowly avoiding an interception and then taking a third-down sack. Nevertheless, the Bengals came up short when Jayden Daniels led the Commanders on a five-play, 64-yard game-winning march, but Burrow finished with his fourth tally of at least 300 passing yards this season. He'll look to put his team back in the win column in a favorable Week 12 home matchup against the Saints on Sunday.

inj_report.short: Stroud completed 21 of 26 passes for 194 yards with three touchdowns and one interception and rushed six times for 27 yards in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.
inj_report.long: Stroud's night got off to a rocky start when a deflected pass resulted in an interception on the Texans' opening drive, but the red-hot signal-caller was near perfect from that point forward. The 2023 first-round pick went on to toss three touchdown passes for the second straight game and multiple scores for the fifth consecutive contest overall. Stroud connected with Nico Collins (42 yards), Kayshon Boutte (24 yards) and Marlin Klein (13 yards) for his trio of scoring strikes, and he'll take a sparkling 22:4 TD:INT into a Week 12 home matchup against the Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 29.

inj_report.short: Daniels completed 23 of 35 passes for 289 yards with no touchdowns or interceptions and added six carries for 55 yards in the Commanders' 22-20 win over the Bengals on Monday night.
inj_report.long: Daniels looked like he was on his way to a middling night during a first half in which he led the Commanders to just seven points, but the 2024 first-round pick flipped a switch in the second half, particularly in the fourth quarter. Daniels led field-goal drives of 13, 11 and five plays that netted a total of 193 yards during the final period, the last one featuring strikes of 22 and 42 yards to Antonio Williams to position Drew Stevens for a game-winning field goal. Daniels finished with his second-highest passing yardage total of the season, and he also mustered his seventh interception-free effort of the campaign. Having helped Washington to a critical victory, he'll look to carry the momentum over into a favorable Week 12 road matchup against the Cardinals on Sunday.

inj_report.long: It was the third time this season St. Brown has hauled in more than 140 yards in a game, but he got shut out of the end zone as Jahmyr Gibbs did most of the scoring for the Lions. St. Brown has caught at least seven passes in four of the last six games, and through 11 contests he's racked up a 77-938-8 line on 107 targets. He'll look to reach 1,000 yards for the fifth straight season in Week 13 on the road against the Falcons.

inj_report.short: Williams said after Thursday's 39-35 win in Detroit that he's "fine" and likely just has "a bruise on his abdomen," Jason Lieser of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.
inj_report.long: Williams seemingly went for a precautionary X-ray after Week 12 action due to a "weird fall" that occurred during Thursday's contest in which he engineered two TD drives in the final 8:20 of the fourth quarter to eke out a four-point victory. He completed 30 of 44 passes for 345 yards, two touchdowns and no interceptions and recorded three carries for 15 yards. With plenty of time to recover before the Bears' next game Sunday, Dec. 6 against the Jaguars, Williams has a decent chance to avoid practice restrictions next week.

inj_report.short: Prescott completed 19 of 28 passes for 291 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Thursday's 39-38 loss to the Eagles. He added 19 yards and a TD on two carries.
inj_report.long: The Cowboys held a 28-10 lead at the half and were up 38-24 early in the fourth quarter, but abysmal efforts by the defense and special teams squandered Prescott's third straight game producing at least three touchdowns. It was the first time since Week 8 that he failed to reach 300 passing yards, but the 33-year-old QB is still on course for a career-best campaign. He'll take a 27:7 TD:INT, along with three rushing scores, into a much tougher Week 13 tilt against the Seahawks.

inj_report.short: Goff completed 25 of 36 passes for 313 yards and one touchdown with one interception in Thursday's 39-35 loss to the Bears. He added 10 rushing yards on three carries.
inj_report.long: The veteran QB topped 300 passing yards for the fifth time this season, but Goff's only touchdown came on an 11-yard connection with Sam LaPorta in the second quarter, as Jahmyr Gibbs did most of the scoring for the Lions. Goff has thrown multiple TDs in just two of the last five games, a stretch in which he's managed a 7:5 TD:INT, but he could pop for a ceiling game in Week 13 against a struggling Falcons defense.

inj_report.short: Allen completed 10 of 21 passes for 81 yards with no touchdowns and two interceptions and added seven carries for 43 yards in the Bills' 13-10 win over the Chiefs on Thursday.
inj_report.long: Allen's abysmal numbers tell the tale of how difficult a night it was for the star signal-caller under less-than-ideal weather conditions and while facing a talented veteran defense. Allen's passing yardage total was a season low, and the two-interception  tally was his second straight. Allen also took a pair of sacks and completed a season-worst 47.6 percent of his passes, but he helped bring Buffalo back from a 10-7 fourth-quarter deficit. Allen's lackluster showing aside, he'll remain an elite option in all formats for a Week 13 road divisional clash against the Patriots on Sunday, Dec. 6.

inj_report.short: Lamb caught seven of 11 targets for 134 yards in Thursday's 39-38 loss to the Eagles.
inj_report.long: He was once again Dak Prescott's top downfield option, leading the Cowboys in targets, catches and receiving yards, but KaVontae Turpin and Javonte Williams were on the other end of the QB's touchdown passes. Lamb has topped 100 yards in six of 12 games this season, including three of the last four, and he'll carry a 95-1,242-9 line on 144 targets into a tough Week 13 battle against the Seahawks.

inj_report.short: Robinson rushed 16 times for 71 yards and a touchdown and brought in four of five targets for six yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons on Sunday.
inj_report.long: The Falcons were down 14-3 by halftime and 21-3 doing into the final period, so Robinson's opportunities progressively dwindled due to game script. However, the star running back still averaged a solid 4.4 yards per carry and recorded his sixth rushing touchdown of the season on a three-yard run in the fourth quarter. Robinson has at least four receptions in three of the last four games, and he'll now have a Week 11 bye to rest up before a tough Week 12 road matchup against the Vikings on Sunday, Nov. 29.

inj_report.short: Williams carried the ball 29 times for 101 yards and two touchdowns while catching all three of his targets for 22 yards and a third TD in Thursday's 39-38 loss to the Eagles.
inj_report.long: All three scores came in the first half as the Cowboys raced out to a 28-10 lead, making Williams the first player with three TDs in a half on Thanksgiving since Brian Westbrook accomplished the feat with Philly in 2008. Williams is also the second RB in Cowboys history to have multiple games in a season with three or more scores, something Emmitt Smith pulled off in four separate campaigns. He's also reached 100 rushing yards in three of the last six games, and he's topped 1,000 yards from scrimmage for the second straight year in Dallas. Williams will look to keep rolling in Week 13 against the Seahawks.

inj_report.short: Chase secured five of nine targets for 31 yards in the Bengals' 22-20 loss to the Commanders on Monday night.
inj_report.long: The Commanders focused on keeping Chase in check after his 231-yard outburst against the Steelers in Week 10, and they executed that plan to near perfection. The superstar wideout finished with his third-lowest yardage total of the season, and his sparsest since Week 4. Chase still extended his streak of five-plus-catch efforts to six games, and he'll look to bounce back to his usual level of production in a Week 12 home matchup against a vulnerable Saints defense Sunday.

inj_report.short: Johnson rushed 17 times for 72 yards and a touchdown and brought in all four targets for 24 yards in the Chiefs' 13-10 loss to the Bills on Thursday.
inj_report.long: Making a third straight start in place of Kenneth Walker (groin), Johnson put together another useful all-around performance that included his third rushing touchdown of the season on a one-yard run early in the third quarter. Johnson also recorded at least four catches for the third consecutive game, and he's now accumulated 410 scrimmage yards and four total TDs over his three starts. Walker is likely to be back for next Thursday's Week 13 road showdown against the Rams, but Johnson is likely to retain a solid complementary role even when his star teammate is back on the field.

inj_report.short: Smith completed 17 of 21 passes for 176 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers. He also rushed once for four yards.
inj_report.long: Smith didn't have a completion longer than 21 yards but kept the offense on schedule with an accurate performance. Most importantly, he stepped up in the red zone, which has been the team's Achilles' heel throughout the season. Smith threw a seven-yard touchdown pass to Breece Hall to snap the Jets' two-game touchdown drought in the second quarter, then tacked on touchdown passes of eight and 15 yards to practice-squad elevation Sterling Shepard. The veteran QB will take a 15:3 TD:INT into a Week 12 road game against the Dolphins, who defeated the Jets in Week 7 despite three touchdown passes from Smith.

inj_report.short: Jefferson caught seven of nine targets for 86 yards and lost a fumble in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.
inj_report.long: Jefferson has experienced an uptick in usage since the Vikings reacquired Kirk Cousins. The star WR has 16 catches for 160 yards on 22 targets in two games with Cousins, though Jefferson hasn't scored since Week 8. Jefferson fumbled at the end of a 25-yard catch in the third quarter, turning what would have been one of his best plays of the night into a lowlight. Another heavy dose of targets from Cousins likely awaits Jefferson in Week 12 against the Falcons.

inj_report.short: Cousins completed 26 of 38 passes for 235 yards, no touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers. He also rushed once for no gain.
inj_report.long: After throwing a pick-six among his three interceptions when he faced San Francisco's defense in his final game with the Raiders in Week 9, Cousins had another interception returned for a touchdown by the 49ers in the second quarter of Sunday's loss. The Vikings took a 28-10 deficit into the halftime locker room, and Cousins was unable to orchestrate a comeback before Minnesota waved the white flag and inserted Carson Wentz for its final drive. Cousins is still strengthening his grasp on the offense two games into his reunion with the Vikings ahead of a Week 12 visit from the Falcons, with whom Cousins spent the previous two seasons.

inj_report.short: Collins secured three of five targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.
inj_report.long: Facing a Colts defense down both Sauce Gardner (calf) and Charvarius Ward (knee), Collins looked primed for a big night early when he recorded a 42-yard touchdown grab to cap off Houston's second possession. However, C.J. Stroud proceeded to spread the ball around to nine different targets overall, leading to Collins tying his second-lowest reception tally and posting his third-lowest yardage total of the season. However, the star wideout did extend his touchdown streak to three games, and he'll next take aim at what has been an inconsistent Ravens secondary in a Week 12 home matchup on Sunday, Nov. 29.

inj_report.short: Cook rushed 32 times for 117 yards and a touchdown and brought in his only target for eight yards in the Bills' 13-10 win over the Chiefs on Thursday.
inj_report.long: Cook logged a season high in rush attempts while eclipsing the century mark for the third time in the last four games. Cook's longest gain went for only 10 yards, so he worked hard for everything he got against a tough Chiefs front. Cook added his 11th rushing touchdown of the season on a five-yard run early in the second quarter, and he'll have some extra recovery time before he takes aim at the Patriots defense in a Week 13 road matchup on Sunday, Dec. 6.

inj_report.short: Love completed 17 of 29 passes for 198 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions and rushed once for seven yards in the Packers' 26-13 loss to the Rams on Wednesday night.
inj_report.long: Love already had a daunting challenge coming in against a talented Rams secondary. It was made exponentially more difficult due to Christian Watson, to whom he threw his only touchdown pass of the night in the second quarter from six yards out, exiting the game for good late in the first half due to a possible concussion. The veteran signal-caller unsurprisingly scuffled throughout, and his two interceptions came in the second half while the game was still within reach for Green Bay. The game marked Love's first with multiple interceptions this season, as well as his third below 200 passing yards. Love will look to bounce back when the Packers return to action on the road against the Saints on Sunday, Dec. 6.

inj_report.short: McCarthy completed 18 of 38 passes for 173 yards with a touchdown and no interceptions and rushed seven times for 33 yards in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday.
inj_report.long: McCarthy had his share of trouble against an aggressive Jaguars defense, leading to a season-worst 47.4 percent completion rate. However, the emerging signal-caller avoided turnovers and connected with Malik Nabers for an eight-yard touchdown pass in the second quarter. McCarthy also provided some timely contributions with his legs, and he's averaging 5.4 yards on his 22 rush attempts to date. McCarthy connected with nine different targets overall as he continues to show good command of the offense, and he'll look to bounce back efficiency-wise in a Week 12 road matchup against the Colts next Sunday.

Rodriguez has logged 63 carries for 261 yards (4.1 YPC) and four touchdowns and caught five of six targets for 49 yards across 10 regular-season games in 2026.

inj_report.long: Despite the high volume of attempts, Shough couldn't get much going through the air while dealing with a ferocious Chicago pass rush that sacked him six times, including one for a fourth-quarter safety by Montez Sweat. Shough has gone four straight games without producing multiple TDs, posting a 4:3 TD:INT over that stretch while completing 67.3 percent of his passes with a weak 6.3 YPA. The second-year QB will likely need to be a lot more productive in Week 12 if the Saints are going to keep up with Joe Burrow and the Bengals.

Colston Loveland (knee) left Thursday's game early, however, which could open up more volume for both of the Bears' top WRs. Burden will look to get rolling in Week 13 against the Jaguars.

inj_report.short: Skattebo rushed 14 times for 34 yards and brought in three of seven targets for 14 yards in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.
inj_report.long: Skattebo was unsurprisingly stymied on the ground by the Jaguars' elite run defense, and he couldn't really make up for it with his work through the air. Skattebo also committed another untimely turnover, fumbling at Jacksonville's 31-yard line with just over four minutes remaining in the third quarter and New York trying to add to a 20-6 lead. The change of possession ultimately didn't lead to any Jaguars points, however, and head coach John Harbaugh showed some faith in the second-year back by affording him the opportunity to ice the upset win with three carries on the final drive. Skattebo proved up to the task by netting 13 yards on those touches to force the Jags to exhaust their timeouts, and he should continue helming the backfield in a Week 12 road matchup against the Colts next Sunday.

inj_report.short: Taylor will be joined in the backfield in Sunday's game against the Giants by Anthony Richardson, who was named the Colts' new starting quarterback after Daniel Jones was cut Friday, Mike Chappell of Fox 59 News Indianapolis reports.
inj_report.long: Taylor is slated to take his first extended snaps alongside Richardson since the 2024 season, when the two started together 10 times. The threat that Richardson presented to defenses as a runner seemed to aid Taylor's own effectiveness, as the running back averaged 4.8 yards per carry and scored eight touchdowns over that 10-game stretch. Now two years later, the Colts have a much less formidable offensive line in place and few established pass-catching weapons that defenses need to hone in on, so Taylor will likely be hard-pressed to match the lofty production he previously achieved with Richardson under center. Additionally, the 3-8 Colts may be cognizant of not overworking Taylor amid a losing season, though the loss of top backup Seth McGowan (hamstring) for at least Week 12 may result in Taylor seeing a slight uptick in opportunities after he played fewer than 70 percent of snaps in each of the last five games and averaged 16.6 touches in those contests.

inj_report.short: Watson completed 25 of 40 passes for 312 yards with no touchdowns and one interception while adding eight rushes for 49 yards and a score in the Browns' 27-24 win over the Texans on Sunday. He also committed a fumble that remained with Cleveland.
inj_report.long: Watson helped the Browns overcome a 17-point first-half deficit, even though he didn't throw any touchdown passes for the fourth straight game. The veteran signal-caller did pile up the passing yardage against his old team, however, eclipsing 300 yards for the third straight game in the process. Watson also hit Harold Fannin with a critical 30-yard pass on his last pass attempt of the afternoon to set up Quinshon Judkins' game-winning rushing touchdown, and he'll next draw a highly favorable matchup against the Raiders in a Week 12 home matchup on Sunday, Nov. 29, following a Week 11 bye.

inj_report.short: Golden secured one of five targets for 39 yards in the Packers' 26-13 loss to the Rams on Wednesday night.
inj_report.long: Golden saw Christian Watson exit for good late in the first half due to a possible concussion, but the former still couldn't capitalize on a night when Jordan Love threw for a modest 198 yards and tossed two interceptions. Golden's yardage total tied for his second-lowest figure of the season, while Wednesday marked his first game without multiple receptions. Golden will look to bounce back in a Week 13 road matchup against the Saints on Sunday, Dec. 6.

inj_report.short: Mayfield completed 20 of 33 passes for 187 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions and rushed six times for 36 yards in the Buccaneers' 31-21 loss to the Lions on Sunday. He also committed a fumble that stayed with Tampa Bay.
inj_report.long: Mayfield fought through foot and thumb injuries to take the field in a critical game for the 3-6 Buccaneers, but he wasn't able to keep pace with Jared Goff and Jahmyr Gibbs. Mayfield did throw multiple touchdown passes for the first time this season, hitting rookie Ted Hurst for scoring strikes of 23 and four yards. Mayfield's rushing yardage total was also a new season high, and he'll next take aim at the Panthers' beatable secondary in a Week 12 divisional home matchup on Monday night, Nov. 30.

inj_report.short: McBride caught nine of 14 targets for 54 yards in Sunday's 34-7 loss to Kansas City. He added four yards on his only carry.
inj_report.long: Working with his fourth quarterback of the season in Josh Johnson, McBride dominated the 40-year-old's attention, as no other Cardinal got more than seven targets or hauled in more than four passes. The star tight end wasn't able to do much with the volume, however, as his longest gain went for a mere nine yards. Carson Beck (back) could be back under center in Week 12 against the Commanders, but that might not improve McBride's outlook, as he saw only five targets in Week 10 during the rookie QB's first NFL start.

inj_report.short: Young completed 22 of 30 passes for 254 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 35-33 win over Baltimore.
inj_report.long: The fourth-year QB posted his best single-game completion rate of the season (73.3 percent) while tossing multiple TDs for the third time in the last six contests, a stretch in which he's compiled a 9:5 TD:INT. Both of Young's scores came in the first half, as he connected with Mitchell Evans on a 23-yard TD and Tetairoa McMillan on a seven-yard strike. Young will look to keep rolling in Week 12 against Tampa Bay.

inj_report.short: Darnold (quadriceps) doesn't have a designation for Sunday's game at San Francisco, Gregg Bell of Sports Radio 93.3 KJR Seattle reports.
inj_report.long: Darnold thus is returning from a two-game absence due to a quad injury and cracked ribs, benefiting from the Seahawks' Week 11 bye. When asked if Darnold is 100 percent, head coach Mike Macdonald told Bell that "pretty much nobody is fully health at this point in the season," indicating that the quarterback still may be dealing with residual effects of those health concerns. In any case, Darnold will resume starting duties for the Seahawks this weekend.

inj_report.short: Stevenson was not listed on the Patriots' practice report Wednesday.
inj_report.long: Stevenson hurt his knee in Week 9 against Green Bay and initially appeared slated to miss multiple games. However, he surprisingly was able to suit up in Week 10 against Detroit in Munich, Germany, though he logged just a 44 percent offensive snap share and gained only five yards on seven touches. Stevenson is now off the injury report entirely to begin Week 12 prep following New England's Week 11 bye, suggesting that the knee issue is no longer a concern. The veteran running back commented Wednesday on his ability to suit up in Week 10, attributing it to "a bunch of recovery" and sharing, "(The trainers) did a good job of just getting me available again... Leg wasn't feeling 100 percent, but I was well enough to go out there and participate with the team and try to help them out a little bit," per Sophie Weller of Patriots Wire. With no practice restrictions to begin Week 12 prep, Stevenson should be set to suit up this Sunday  in Los Angeles against the Chargers, when he'll be taking handoffs from QB Tommy DeVito.

inj_report.short: Williams rushed 12 times for 46 yards and a touchdown and brought in four of five targets for 19 yards in the Rams' 26-13 win over the Packers on Wednesday night.
inj_report.long: Williams had already been losing ground to Blake Corum in recent weeks, but the latter's takeover of the ground attack may have been finalized Wednesday with his career-best 184-yard, one-touchdown effort. Williams logged his final three carries on the Rams' final drive, but Corum was in the clear lead role throughout the majority of the night. Williams did add his seventh rushing touchdown of the campaign on a seven-yard run early in the second quarter, and his backseat role may have been influenced in part by the turf toe injury he's been dealing with for the past month. Nonetheless, Williams could be destined for a true complementary role if McVay opts to center the ground game on Corum moving forward.

inj_report.short: Swift carried the ball nine times for 65 yards and a touchdown and caught seven of eight targets for 97 yards in Thursday's 39-35 win over the Lions.
inj_report.long: While Kyle Monangai swooped in to score two TDs at the goal line, Swift put up impressive numbers of his own, leading the Bears in both rushing and receiving yards while hitting paydirt on a 30-yard run in the third quarter. The seven grabs and 97 receiving yards were both season highs for Swift, and the added volume came as a result of Colston Loveland's early exit due to a knee injury. If Loveland ends up missing more time, Swift's usage as a pass catcher could get a boost again in Week 13 against the Jaguars. He's already been plenty busy on that front this season, and through 11 contests he's compiled 959 scrimmage yards and a career-high 12 total TDs (10 rushing, two receiving).

inj_report.short: Pickens caught five of nine targets for 67 yards in Thursday's 39-38 loss to the Eagles.
inj_report.long: It was a step back for Pickens after he hauled in 18 of 28 targets for 247 yards and four TDs over the prior two games. The 25-year-old wideout is the clear No. 2 option in the Dallas passing attack behind CeeDee Lamb, but the team's woeful defense and limited depth behind the duo ensures that Pickens will see big volume from Dak Prescott more often than not. Pickens will take a 62-847-6 line on 99 targets into a Week 13 clash with the Seahawks.

inj_report.short: Head coach Kevin Stefanski said Monday that London was cleared of a concussion near the end of Sunday's 35-13 loss to the Chiefs, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.
inj_report.long: London was checked for a possible concussion in the fourth quarter of Week 10 action, but the result of the evaluation wasn't reported before the game concluded. Prior to his exit Sunday, he posted his third 100-yard game (109, to be exact) of the campaign on six catches and a season-high 12 targets. London will continue to operate as the Falcons' No. 1 WR after a Week 11 bye in the team's next game Sunday, Nov. 29, at Minnesota.

inj_report.short: Milton completed 21 of 31 passes for 331 yards and three touchdowns with one interception in Thursday's 39-38 win over the Cowboys. He added 15 yards and a TD on three carries.
inj_report.long: Facing the team who put him on the practice squad to begin the season before he got signed by the Eagles, Milton used his mobility to keep plays alive and find receivers deep against an inept Cowboys secondary. The 26-year-old QB connected with DeVonta Smith for TDs of 50 yards in the second quarter and 45 yards in the third, before a big fourth quarter in which Milton ran in a 15-yard score of his own and then found Makai Lemon for a 15-yard strike as Philly erased a 38-24 deficit. Milton's 331 passing yards weren't just a career high, they were more than he produced in his first two starts this season combined. He'll remain under center against another struggling defense as he faces the Cardinals in Week 13.

inj_report.short: Bowers (ankle) will be listed as questionable for Sunday night's game against the Browns, Adam Hill of the Las Vegas Review-Journal reports.
inj_report.long: Per Sam Warren of The Athletic, Bowers didn't practice on Friday after being limited the previous two days. It's unclear if the star TE's 'DNP' to close the week was maintenance or setback-related, but the Raiders' late kickoff presents an issue for those considering Bowers in Week 12 fantasy lineups. As one of the marquee names carrying a 'questionable' tag into the weekend, look for added context regarding his status to arrive no later than Saturday night or Sunday morning by via the usual notable NFL insiders.

inj_report.short: Stafford completed 16 of 23 passes for 141 yards with no touchdowns and one interception and rushed once for no gain in the Rams' 26-13 win over the Packers on Wednesday night. He also committed a fumble recovered by Los Angeles.
inj_report.long: Playing his second game without both Puka Nacua (IR, knee/toe) and Davante Adams (IR, hamstring), Stafford saw a notable downturn in his numbers and posted a new season low in passing yards. The veteran signal-caller also threw an interception for the fifth straight game, although his pick Wednesday didn't lead to any Packers points since Los Angeles intercepted Jordan Love just two plays later. Stafford also failed to throw a touchdown pass for only the second time this season, and the fact he also lost tight ends Tyler Higbee (chest) and Davis Allen (ankle) to in-game injuries didn't help his cause. On the positive side, there's an outside chance Stafford has Adams back in the fold for a Week 13 home showdown against the Chiefs on Thursday, Dec. 3.

inj_report.short: Nix completed 19 of 35 passes for 225 yards, one touchdown and one interception and notched six carries for five yards during Sunday's 38-24 victory against the Raiders.
inj_report.long: After a hit-or-miss first six appearances of the season, Nix has settled into a four-game stretch in which his passing yards have ranged from 222 to 237 weekly, a span in which he boasts a 6:2 TD:INT and 84 rushing yards and another score. He also displayed some promise with offseason acquisition Jaylen Waddle (3-61-0 on six targets) while connecting with TE Adam Trautman for his 12th touchdown pass in 10 contests. Nix will look to keep things rolling Friday at Pittsburgh.

inj_report.short: Smith (back) was seen limping badly in the locker room after Thursday's 39-38 win over the Cowboys, Martin Frank of the Delaware News Journal reports.
inj_report.long: Smith put together a career stat line during the Eagles' Thanksgiving Day win, with the veteran wide receiver hauling in 11 of 14 targets for 200 yards and two touchdowns. He was in and out of the game after landing hard on his tailbone on one of his targets in the fourth quarter and was in noticeable pain when on the field. Smith will have additional time to rest courtesy of the Thursday game, but his status over the coming days will be worth monitoring ahead of the Eagles' Week 13 road tilt against the Cardinals on Sunday, Dec. 6.

inj_report.short: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said Monday that DeVito is the team's starting quarterback, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports. "We're excited about that. He had a good preseason, and Tommy's improved," Vrabel said of DeVito.
inj_report.long: With Drake Maye (fibula) hurt early in Week 10 against Detroit, DeVito stepped in at quarterback but managed to complete just 12 of 24 pass attempts for 81 yards, a touchdown and an interception. He added 19 yards on four carries. The 28-year-old does have some starting experience -- he helmed the Giants offense for eight starts between 2023 and 2024 -- but he didn't play at all in 2025. For now, the Patriots are at least communicating that they'll stand pat and not look for help at quarterback outside the organization. However, the team is barely hanging on in the AFC playoff race with a 5-5 record, and with only rookie Behren Morton on the active roster as a healthy option to DeVito, the team may still look elsewhere if DeVito is unable to show better production.

inj_report.long: Henry has cleared concussion protocol after practicing without limitations Thursday and Friday. He'll try to help the Ravens snap a six-game losing streak Sunday against the Texans. Running room could be hard to come by against a stout Houston front that's allowing fewer than 100 rushing yards per game, though Henry has overcome more than his fair share of daunting matchups over the years.

inj_report.short: Brown rushed six times for six yards and brought in five of eight targets for 30 yards in the Bengals' 22-20 loss to the Commanders on Monday night.
inj_report.long: As his final line indicates, Brown was completely stonewalled by a talented Commanders run defense, although backfield mate Samaje Perine, who equaled Brown's carry total, was able to average 4.3 yards per tote with his opportunities and  added 71 receiving yards. Brown did find a way to make his usual impact as a receiver, tying for the team lead in receptions and finishing second in targets to Ja'Marr Chase. Brown's carry and rushing yardage totals were both season lows, but he should have appreciably better conditions for production on the ground in a Week 12 home matchup against the Saints on Sunday.

inj_report.short: Williams caught six of nine targets for 68 yards in Thursday's 39-35 loss to the Bears. He added 12 yards on his lone carry.
inj_report.long: The fifth-year wideout finished second on the Lions in targets, catches and receiving yards to Amon-Ra St. Brown (7-146-0 on 10 targets), a position that Williams is very used to finding himself in. Williams tied his season high in receptions with the performance, and he'll take a 42-679-6 line on 64 targets through 11 games into a Week 13 clash with the Falcons.

inj_report.short: Coach Mike LaFleur has ruled out Carson Beck (back) for Sunday's game against the Commanders, which sets the stage for Johnson to start the contest, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.
inj_report.long: Johnson, who completed 18 of 31 passes for 155 yards and a touchdown in a 34-7 loss to Kansas City in Week 11, is thus set to make his second straight start for the Cardinals. With no teams on bye this week, Johnson's Week 12 fantasy utility is limited to Superflex formats and to fantasy managers scrambling for a short-term injury replacement at the QB position.

inj_report.short: Ward completed 21 of 30 passes for 248 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions while rushing twice for three yards and another score in the Titans' 51-30 loss to the Cowboys on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.
inj_report.long: Ward's final line belies his struggles somewhat, as a Cowboys defense that made a defensive playcaller switch brought him down for five sacks and forced a lost fumble on one of them at Dallas' 20-yard line. Ward did manage to connect with Carnell Tate (59 yards) and Calvin Ridley (12 yards) for his pair of TD passes, the first coming when the rookie wideout alertly got up after not being touched and the second on a broken play where Ward threw across the field after buying several extra seconds with his legs. Ward also had a one-yard touchdown run in the third quarter, and despite Tennessee's team-level misery, the second-year signal-caller has thrown for at least 231 yards and two touchdowns in three consecutive games heading into a Week 12 road matchup against the Jaguars next Sunday.

inj_report.short: Brissett completed 24 of 37 passes for 276 yards and a touchdown with an interception in Sunday's 35-33 loss to the Panthers. He added seven rushing yards on two carries.
inj_report.long: It was another decent showing for the veteran quarterback, and his first TD pass in two games as a Raven came on a trick that involved a direct snap to Derrick Henry, who flipped it Brissett for a 52-yard strike to Rashod Bateman. Brissett has also kept Zay Flowers relevant, feeding the wideout 18 targets for a 14-171-0 line. Baltimore's passing attack will try to keep improving in Week 12 against the Texans.

inj_report.short: Jeanty tallied 11 carries for 79 yards and gathered in five of eight targets for 90 yards and one touchdown during Sunday's 38-24 loss at Denver.
inj_report.long: Jeanty's 169 yards from scrimmage amounted to the second-highest single-game total of his career after going for 188 such yards against the Texans in Week 16 of last season. His performance was fueled by a 68-yard catch and run for a touchdown and a 46-yard rush, the latter of which marked his first of 20-plus yards on the campaign. Jeanty also broke a streak of four straight contests falling short of 10 carries, but considering No. 2 RB Mike Washington also earned nine runs in Week 11, the Raiders backfield remains a committee ahead of next Sunday's outing at Cleveland.

inj_report.short: LaPorta caught four of five targets for 44 yards and a touchdown in Thursday's 39-35 loss to the Bears.
inj_report.long: Despite the high score, Jared Goff threw only one TD pass on the afternoon, connecting with LaPorta for an 11-yard strike in the second quarter, The tight end snapped a five-game touchdown drought in the process, but he still hasn't topped four catches or 62 yards in six contests since Detroit's bye. LaPorta will take a 43-521-4 line on 64 targets through 11 games into a Week 13 clash with the Falcons.

inj_report.short: Odunze caught six of nine targets for 87 yards and two touchdowns in Thursday's 39-35 win over the Lions.
inj_report.long: The third-year wideout played hero in the fourth quarter on Thanksgiving. With the Bears down 35-24, Odunze hauled in a 41-yard strike from Caleb Williams (abdomen)  and then went up for a six-yard score in the back corner of the end zone with just three seconds left on the clock. Odunze sports a 42-660-3 line on 64 targets through 11 games, and if Colston Loveland (knee) ends up missing more time after exiting Thursday's game early, there could be more looks available for him in a Week 13 tilt against the Jaguars.

inj_report.short: Diggs (personal) was removed from the Commanders' injury report Thursday.
inj_report.long: Diggs had an excused absence Wednesday but avoided the injury report entirely one day later, setting him up to continue to serve as Washington's clear-cut No. 1 wide receiver. Since Terry McLaurin was lost for the season due to a torn patellar tendon that he suffered in Week 6 at San Francisco, Diggs has compiled a 16-217-2 line on 27 targets over the last four games.

inj_report.short: Mendoza was 18-for-37 passing for 267 yards, three touchdowns and one interception and had four carries for 22 yards during Sunday's 38-24 loss in Denver.
inj_report.long: After throwing for no touchdowns or interceptions in his first NFL start last Sunday against the Seahawks, Mendoza recorded the first scoring strike of his career on a 68-yard catch and run via RB Ashton Jeanty in Week 11. Mendoza also hooked up with Ian Thomas (19 yards) and Jack Bech (seven yards) for his other two TDs, but he followed up a 58.6 completion percentage in Week 10 with more misfires (19) than connections (18) this Sunday. Mendoza's next chance for game action is next Sunday at Cleveland.

inj_report.short: Meyers (ankle) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Titans, Ryan O'Halloran of the Florida Times-Union reports.
inj_report.long: Meyers has managed to shake off an ankle injury that limited his practice participation earlier in the week. He racked up a season-high 85 yards on 10 targets in Jacksonville's Week 11 loss to the Giants, and Meyers is likely to get plenty of attention from Trevor Lawrence against Tennessee's league-worst secondary Sunday in the absence of top Jaguars wide receiver Parker Washington (shoulder), giving Meyers appealing upside in nearly all fantasy formats.

inj_report.short: Etienne carried the ball 14 times for 76 yards and failed to catch his only target in Sunday's 21-13 loss to Chicago.
inj_report.long: The former Jaguar was the clear No. 1 option in the backfield for the Saints. Alvin Kamara saw just two touches and CJ Donaldson handled five, although Kamara did vulture another red-zone TD on a one-yard reception in the second quarter, Most of Etienne's production came on a 46-yard scamper that saw him tackled just short of the goal line, setting up Kamara's score, but the fact that he was able to produce his first big play as a Saint was still encouraging. Etienne will attempt to build on this performance in Week 12 against the Bengals.

inj_report.short: Loveland (knee) is slated to get a second opinion on his knee injury and won't be placed on injured reserve for now, though he is considered week-to-week, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
inj_report.long: Schefter reported earlier that the Bears planned to place Loveland on injured reserve due to the knee injury the TE sustained in Thursday's 39-35 win over the Lions, which would rule Loveland out for at least four weeks. Chicago wants to gather more information before a determination is made on Loveland's status, and the door is still open for a shorter absence, though it would be surprising at this point if he's able to play Dec. 6 against the Jaguars.

inj_report.short: Penix completed 23 of 43 passes for 286 yards with no touchdowns and one interception and rushed four times for 29 yards in the Falcons' 35-13 loss to the Chiefs on Sunday. He also fumbled once but recovered.
inj_report.long: Penix struggled while the game was still in question, but he did manage to pad his stats some down the stretch as the Falcons unsuccessfully tried to overcome their deficit. Penix connected with eight different targets overall on the afternoon, and he ultimately finished with a season high in passing yards. Penix has now tossed six interceptions in the last three games, however, and he'll look to regroup during the Week 11 bye before tackling a difficult matchup against the Vikings on the road on Sunday, Nov. 29.

inj_report.short: McConkey caught five of eight targets for 37 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets.
inj_report.long: His longest gain went for just 11 yards, but McConkey was deadly in the red zone, connecting with Justin Herbert on scores of 11 and six yards in the fourth quarter as the Chargers tried to mount a late comeback. Herbert was placed in the concussion protocol after the game after taking six sacks, and if he end up missing any time, it would put a big damper on McConkey's fantasy outlook with undrafted rookie DJ Uiagalelei being the Bolts' backup, unless Trey Lance (groin) is able to return from IR. McConkey has had plenty of trouble staying on the field himself this year, of course, and he'll take a 22-323-3 line on 32 targets through seven contests into a Week 12 clash with the Patriots.

inj_report.short: Uiagalelei will be the Chargers' starting quarterback against the Patriots on Sunday due to the absence of Justin Herbert (concussion), Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.
inj_report.long: Uiagalelei got his first taste of NFL regular-season action in Week 11 against the Jets after Herbert suffered a concussion, with the former completing two of seven passes for 27 yards and a touchdown. With Herbert in the league's concussion protocol, Uiagalelei will make his first career start Sunday against a Patriots defense that ranks 27th in the NFL in passing yards allowed per game (239.0). Jake Browning is also available to serve as Los Angeles' backup.

inj_report.short: Rudolph will start Friday's game against the Broncos and could remain atop the depth chart for the rest of the season with the Steelers waiving Aaron Rodgers on Wednesday.
inj_report.long: Late Tuesday, the Steelers opted to make a change under center, naming Rudolph the Week 12 starter and sending Rodgers to the bench on the heels of poor performances by the offense in back-to-back losses to the Bengals and Eagles coming out of a bye week. The Steelers initially planned to make Rodgers inactive for Week 12 but keep him on the roster, but the team now intends to part ways with the four-time MVP after he harshly criticized head coach Mike McCarthy during an appearance on "The Pat McAfee Show" on Wednesday. The impending departure of Rodgers should thus give Rudolph an extended leash as the Steelers' starter, with a pair of inexperienced quarterbacks in second-year man Will Howard and rookie third-round pick Drew Allar representing the other options behind him on the depth chart. Over 38 career appearances (19 starts), the 31-year-old Rudolph has completed 64.2 percent of his passes for 6.6 yards per attempt and a 30:22 TD:INT.

inj_report.short: Rice brought in two of five targets for 19 yards in the Chiefs' 13-10 loss to the Bills on Thursday.
inj_report.long: Rice's production was part of the collateral damage of a night that was unconducive for offense, as the veteran receiver tied his lowest reception and receiving yardage totals of the season for a non-injury-shortened game. Rice came in riding a solid four-game stretch where he'd generated a 23-237-1 line on 27 targets, and he'll look to return to that level of production during a Week 13 road matchup against the Rams next Thursday.

inj_report.long: Tate had a fairly non-descript day overall despite the Titans' 30-point output, but he rewarded fantasy managers with a 59-yard catch-and run touchdown in the third quarter on which he alertly got up and ran down the left sideline after Cowboys defenders failed to touch him while he was down. The rookie fourth overall pick was making his return from a two-game absence due to a shoulder injury, and the score served as Tate's second of his career, both which have come in his last three games. Tate has at least 58 receiving yards in five of the last six contests, including in three straight, heading into a Week 12 road matchup against the Jaguars next Sunday.

inj_report.long: One week after logging 13 targets as Tyler Shough's top downfield option, Tyson all but disappeared as Chris Olave instead saw WR1-worthy volume. The Saints' aerial attack simply may not be able to support both wideouts in the same game, which would mark Tyson as a volatile, but high-ceiling, fantasy asset for the rest of the season. The rookie will try to bounce back in Week 12 against the Bengals.

inj_report.short: Corum rushed 32 times for 184 yards and a touchdown and brought in two of three targets for 21 yards in the Rams' 26-13 win over the Packers on Wednesday. He also recovered a fumble.
inj_report.long: Corum's stock had already been trending firmly up in recent weeks, but Wednesday may ultimately go down as the day he formally took the reins of the ground attack from Kyren Williams. The 2024 third-round pick compiled a career-best rushing total while also becoming the first Rams running back to reach the 30-carry threshold in a game during the Sean McVay era that began in 2017. Corum has now logged double-digit carries in five consecutive games, and he capped off his night with productive runs of seven, nine and 29 yards on Los Angeles' game-sealing drive. Corum's fantasy value naturally skyrocketed with Wednesday's performance, and he'll look to build on the outstanding performance in a Week 13 home matchup against the Chiefs on Thursday, Dec. 3.

inj_report.short: Jones rushed eight times for 30 yards and a touchdown while catching his lone target for 13 yards in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.
inj_report.long: Jones tied the game with an 11-yard rushing touchdown in the first quarter, but the 49ers outscored the Vikings 21-3 in the second quarter, forcing Minnesota into a more pass-heavy approach. Jordan Mason led the team with 38 rushing yards on 11 carries. Jones and Mason should continue to split carries in Week 12 against the Falcons, with Jones offering greater upside as a pass catcher.

inj_report.long: Coker endured a helmet-to-helmet hit at the end of a six-yard catch in the fourth quarter of Sunday's win against the Ravens, getting shaken up in the process. Afterward, be reportedly entered the concussion protocol, but one day later he doesn't have a head injury. Coker thus is in the clear ahead of next Monday's game at Tampa Bay.

inj_report.short: Hampton carried the ball 14 times for 89 yards and caught his only target for four yards in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets.
inj_report.long: While he's still not seeing a consistent bell-cow workload, Hampton has turned his season around over the last three games, racking up 254 rushing yards and a TD while averaging 5.2 yards per carry. Keaton Mitchell left Sunday's game early with a knee injury, but his absence appeared to provide a bigger boost to Kimani Vidal, who wound up logging nine touches and 54 scrimmage yards. Hampton will look to keep rolling in Week 12 against the Patriots.

inj_report.short: Montgomery operated as the Texans' RB1 against the Colts in Week 11, but he could see a dip in touches on offense due to the impending return of Woody Marks (concussion) for Sunday's game against the Ravens.
inj_report.long: Marks was in the league's concussion protocol for Week 11, when Montgomery led the Texans' backfield with 26 carries for 107 yards and three catches (on four targets) for 17 yards in a 26-3 win over the Colts. Marks' return means the second-year pro and Montgomery will share the field Sunday for the first time since Week 5 against the Titans, when the latter suffered a groin injury that caused him to miss the Texans' next four games. The duo should split work Sunday against a Baltimore defense that has given up at least 146 rushing yards in three of the team's last four games (all losses).

inj_report.short: Hockenson (wrist) caught six of seven targets for 55 yards in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.
inj_report.long: In his return from a one-game absence, Hockenson finished second on the team in receiving yards behind Justin Jefferson's 86. Hockenson showed promising chemistry with Kirk Cousins after the veteran TE sat out Cousins' return to Minnesota during the Week 10 win over Green Bay. Cousins was under center for the Vikings in the 2023 regular season, when Hockenson set career highs with 95 catches for 960 yards. Hockenson hasn't surpassed 455 yards in a regular season since, though he's on pace to do so this year, with 41 catches for 383 yards and three touchdowns through nine appearances heading into a Week 12 home game against the Falcons.

inj_report.long: Goedert injured his right shoulder during the first half of Thursday's game and was not cleared to return. He'll undergo further tests to determine the severity of the injury, but the veteran tight end is certainly in jeopardy of not being available for the Eagles' Week 13 road tilt against the Cardinals on Sunday, Dec. 6. Johnny Mundt, Zach Ertz and rookie second-rounder Eli Stowers would all be in line for larger roles on offense if Goedert were to miss time.

inj_report.short: Kraft brought in three of five targets for 24 yards in the Packers' 26-13 loss to the Rams on Wednesday night. He also lost a fumble.
inj_report.long: Kraft finished second in receptions and tied for the team lead in targets for the Packers on a night when Jordan Love threw for under 200 yards. The veteran tight end saw Christian Watson exit the game twice with thigh and head injuries in the first half, the latter issue forcing his exit for the rest of the game. Kraft recorded multiple receptions for the first time in three contests in the process, but his first-quarter fumble led to a Rams field goal. Kraft carries an unremarkable 40-394-3 line heading into a Week 13 road matchup against the Saints on Sunday, Dec. 6.

inj_report.short: Fannin (groin) was listed as a full practice participant on Thursday's injury report, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.
inj_report.long: The Browns didn't hold a practice on Thanksgiving Day, but the fact that Fannin was estimated as a full participant Thursday indicates that the second-year tight end is on track to play against the Raiders on Sunday. Fannin has caught at least six passes in three of his last four outings, and has compiled a 25-378-1 receiving line on 32 targets over that span.

inj_report.short: Concepcion caught three of eight targets for 21 yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over Houston. He also gained six yards on one carry.
inj_report.long: Concepcion finished second on the Browns in targets behind tight end Harold Fannin, who had nine. However, whereas Fannin was able to turn his looks into seven receptions and 91 yards, Concepcion posted a much more modest 3-21-0 line. The rookie wideout departed to the medical tent during the first half of the game due to an undisclosed issue, but he was able to quickly return. Concepcion hasn't put up prolific numbers this season, but he does have at least three receptions in eight of his 10 appearances. Cleveland is on bye in Week 11, so Concepcion will next suit up Sunday, Nov. 29, against Las Vegas.

inj_report.short: Allgeier carried the ball seven times for 23 yards in Sunday's 34-7 loss to Kansas City.
inj_report.long: Game script fairly quickly put the Cardinals' running game in mothballs, and Allgeier wound up splitting the backfield workload nearly equally with Bam Knight, who picked up 45 scrimmage yards on eight touches. Allgeier has gone three straight games without reaching 50 rushing yards or getting into the end zone, but those games were also against very tough opponents (the Seahawks in Week 9 and the Rams in Week 10). The fifth-year RB could find a little more running room in Week 12 against the Commanders, but Jeremiyah Love (ankle) might also be ready to rejoin the lineup by then.

inj_report.short: Moore hauled in two of six targets for 15 yards in the Bills' 13-10 win over the Chiefs on Thursday.
inj_report.long: Moore's production, like that of the rest of his fellow skill-position players, was very modest on a night when Josh Allen threw for only 81 yards and a pair of interceptions. The talented wideout's catch and yardage totals were both his third-lowest tallies of the season, but Moore is still averaging a formidable 14.6 yards per reception heading into a Week 13 road matchup against the Patriots on Sunday, Dec. 6.

inj_report.short: Henry caught two of three passes for 22 yards during the Patriots' 35-10 loss to the Lions on Sunday in Munich.
inj_report.long: Both of Henry's catches of 10 and 12 yards came on the Patriots' first offensive drive of the game, which ended with a 33-yard field goal by Andy Borregales. Unfortunately for the Patriots, Drake Maye suffered an ankle injury on the play prior to the field goal and was unable to return, and the offense struggled to move down the field with backup Tommy DeVito under center. Maye will undergo more tests once the team has returned to home soil, but the good news for the Patriots is that they are on a bye for Week 11, so the third-year quarterback has more time to heal before New England's next game in Week 12 against the Chargers on Sunday, Nov. 29. Henry's two catches Sunday were his fewest since Week 3 against the Jaguars (one), and the veteran tight end has a 34-383-2 receiving line on 40 targets through 10 regular-season games.

inj_report.short: Perine turned six carries into 26 yards and caught all four of his targets for 71 yards during the Bengals' 22-20 loss to the Commanders on Monday.
inj_report.long: The Commanders' defense focused its attention toward slowing down both Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins. That opened up the field for Perine, with most of his production coming on a 44-yard catch late in the second quarter, and the drive ended two plays later with a 31-yard touchdown pass from Joe Burrow to Higgins. Perine finished second on the Bengals in both catches and receiving yards behind tight end Mike Gesicki, and the RB's 26 rushing yards were well ahead of Chase Brown's six. Perine has at least 10 touches in each of his last three games, but Cincinnati's offense is mustering only 79.4 rushing yards per game, which is third-worst in the NFL. Given Brown's struggles this season, Perine could take on a larger role in the backfield for Week 12 against the Saints on Sunday.

inj_report.short: Cameron is in line to handle a larger role Sunday against the Titans, Demetrius Harvey of the Florida Times-Union reports that Parker Washington (shoulder) won't suit up.
inj_report.long: Cameron and Brian Thomas are the top candidates to absorb extra targets alongside Jakobi Meyers in Washington's absence. Washington is considered week-to-week, so his absence could extend beyond Week 12. Cameron has 111 receiving yards and a touchdown over the past two games, so the rookie sixth-round pick was trending up even prior to Washington's injury. An increased role against a Titans defense that's giving up the most catches and yards per game to wide receivers could set Cameron up for a breakout performance.

inj_report.short: Williams brought in nine of 11 targets for 122 yards in the Commanders' 22-20 win over the Bengals on Monday night.
inj_report.long: The rookie third-round pick managed new career highs across all three components of his receiving line, which also all served as team-best totals Monday. Williams' last two catches of the night were his most critical, as he recorded 22- and 42-yard grabs on Washington's final drive to position Drew Stevens for a game-winning 26-yard field goal. Williams hadn't topped 54 receiving yards in any game after a 64-yard effort in his pro debut in Week 1, but Monday night's breakout could serve as a launchpad to a strong stretch run as the Commanders make a playoff push.

inj_report.short: Kelce brought in four of seven targets for 71 yards in the Chiefs' 13-10 loss to the Bills on Thursday.
inj_report.long: Kelce, who shook off a hard hit to his lower back late in the first half, ended up posting a game-high receiving yardage total with the help of a game-long 24-yard grab that he made late in the first half, and he also tied for the team lead in receptions. The star tight end did have a couple of missed connections with Patrick Mahomes on fourth-quarter drives, however, plays that could have had an impact on the outcome of such a close game. Kelce has exceeded 65 receiving yards in four of the last five games heading into a Week 13 road showdown against the Rams next Thursday night.

Egbuka has now been held under 50 receiving yards in five consecutive contests heading into a Week 12 Monday night home showdown against the Panthers on Nov. 30.

inj_report.short: Allen rushed 16 times for 75 yards while catching his lone target for nine yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers.
inj_report.long: Allen's 16 carries matched his total from the previous two games combined, as he had seen a downtick in opportunities since fellow RB Breece Hall returned from a quadriceps injury. Hall led the backfield once again with 100 scrimmage yards and a touchdown on 23 touches, but Allen was a key part of the game plan as well in the run-heavy win. The Jets will face a one-win team for a second consecutive game in Week 12 at Miami, which could allow Allen to stay involved alongside Hall.

inj_report.long: Even with Omar Cooper (ankle) and Isaiah Williams (ribs) inactive, Mitchell's role didn't change, as his three targets tied with two other teammates for second on the team behind Garrett Wilson's five on a day the Jets called 37 run plays to just 22 passes. Mitchell has just one touchdown this season and has only 14 catches for 212 yards and no touchdowns in six games surrounding his 7-142-1 receiving performance from Week 8 against the Raiders. He's a big-play specialist in an offense that prefers to feed Wilson and its running backs.

He's playable in PPR fantasy leagues as a desperation RB2 option, particularly in games for which the Browns are projected to play from behind.

inj_report.short: Croskey-Merritt rushed 13 times for 54 yards and a touchdown and brought in two of three targets for 23 yards in the Commanders' 22-20 win over the Bengals on Monday night.
inj_report.long: Making his return from a four-game absence due to a groin injury, Croskey-Merritt outpaced Austin Ekeler, the only other Commanders back to log a carry, by six rush attempts. The second-year pro also recorded his third rushing touchdown of the season on a one-yard run with 12 seconds remaining in the first half. Croskey-Merritt averaged over 4.0 yards per carry for the second straight game after failing to eclipse that mark in each of the first four games of the season, and he should be in store for an even busier day in a favorable Week 12 road matchup against the Cardinals on Sunday.

inj_report.long: Dike was able to reel in multiple passes for the third straight game, and his six snags set a new season high for the second-year pro. The 24-year-old paced the team in targets Sunday, narrowly edging out fellow wide receivers Calvin Ridley (six) and Carnell Tate (five). Dike will have a chance to continue carving out a more substantial role for himself on offense moving forward with Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) sidelined for the rest of the 2026 campaign.

inj_report.short: Hollins is set to work in a starting role Sunday against the Chargers, as A.J. Brown (hamstring) and Romeo Doubs (shoulder) won't play.
inj_report.long: Hollins led the Patriots with five catches for 48 yards in their 35-10 Week 10 loss to the Lions prior to a Week 11 bye. He showed the best chemistry out of New England's pass catchers with Tommy DeVito, who replaced Drake Maye (lower leg) against Detroit and is expected to start Sunday's game. Hollins has 23 catches for 293 yards and one touchdown in six appearances this season.

inj_report.short: Mumpfield brought in four of five targets for 69 yards in the Rams' 26-13 win over the Packers on Wednesday night.
inj_report.long: Mumpfield set the pace in receiving yards for the Rams while also sharing the team lead in both receptions and targets. The 2025 seventh-round pick has now posted back-to-back productive games -- he had a 3-81-0 line in the Week 10 win over the Cardinals -- but Wednesday's performance could have been even more rewarding had an apparent two-yard touchdown grab just before the halfway point of the third quarter not been ruled incomplete on replay. Mumpfield should retain a solid No. 2 role even if Davante Adams (IR, hamstring) returns for a Week 13 home matchup against the Chiefs on Thursday, Dec. 3, and the former will retain his No. 1 standing if his star teammate remains sidelined.

inj_report.short: Godwin caught three passes for 18 yards on three targets in Sunday's 31-21 loss to the Lions.
inj_report.long: The veteran wideout ran a team-high 41 routes on Baker Mayfield's 44 dropbacks, but Godwin continues to produce very little with his immense playing time. He's been held under 40 receiving yards in eight straight games and has yet to have a 50-yard receiving game this season. Godwin also has zero touchdowns. He's a low-floor, low-ceiling fantasy option headed into next Monday night's date with the Panthers.

inj_report.short: Pitts brought in four of five targets for 50 yards in the Falcons' 35-13 loss to the Chiefs on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.
inj_report.long: The veteran tight end had a slow start to the day before coming on when the Falcons went especially pass-heavy in the second half. Pitts' fumble, his first of the season, came with just over four minutes remaining in the game after the contest was out of reach, and his catch total was his highest since Week 7. Pitts remains a key complementary option in an Atlanta passing attack that's scuffled of late, and he'll look to bounce back after the Falcons emerge from a Week 11 bye with a Week 12 road matchup against the Vikings on Sunday, Nov. 29.

inj_report.short: Lemon caught five of six targets for 51 yards and a touchdown in Thursday's 39-38 win over the Cowboys.
inj_report.long: The Eagles were down 28-10 at the half and watched Saquon Barkley (neck) and Dallas Goedert (shoulder) exit early, leaving Joe Milton with limited tools at his disposal to put together a comeback. DeVonta Smith saw most of the target volume, but Lemon came up big when it counted, connecting with Milton on a 24-yard TD that brought Philly to within two points with about two minutes left. While a two-point conversion attempt to tie the game failed, the stage was set for a game-winning 59-yard field goal by Jake Elliott in the dying seconds. Lemon has topped 50 yards in four of the last five games, producing a 25-249-2 line on 35 targets over that stretch, and the rookie's role could continue to grow in Week 13 against the Cardinals.

inj_report.long: While the veteran tight end showed some instant chemistry with new quarterback Jacoby Brissett last week, Andrews saw his target volume crater in their second game together, as rookie depth TEs Josh Cuevas and Matthew Hibner saw similar usage as pass catchers. Andrews has failed to reach 25 receiving yards in five of his last six games and hasn't scored a TD in seven straight contests, making him a very risky fantasy option in Week 12 against the Texans.

inj_report.short: Flournoy caught just one pass for 11 yards on one target in Sunday's 51-30 win over the Titans.
inj_report.long: The Cowboys' slot receiver drew just one look on Dak Prescott's 33 pass attempts. He'd caught multiple passes in all 10 games leading up to Sunday's contest. A favorite target of Prescott in the red zone, Flournoy will try to rebound at home against the Eagles on Thanksgiving, when he'll be playable on three-game fantasy slates for Thursday.

inj_report.short: Gesicki brought in five of six targets for 77 yards in the Bengals' 22-20 loss to the Commanders on Monday night.
inj_report.long: The veteran tight end finished with a team-high yardage total while coming just a yard short of equaling his best tally of the season as well. Gesicki's biggest catch came late in the fourth quarter on the Bengals' final drive, when he hauled in a 32-yard pass from Joe Burrow over the middle to get the Bengals down to  the Commanders' 33-yard line. Gesicki's production continues to have some game-to-game volatility, but he'll draw another favorable matchup in a Week 12 home clash with the Saints on Sunday.

inj_report.short: Douglas is set to maintain a prominent role Sunday against the Chargers, as A.J. Brown (hamstring) and Romeo Doubs (shoulder) won't play.
inj_report.long: Douglas had 178 yards and a touchdown in a career-best two-game stretch spanning Weeks 8 and 9, but he was limited to one catch for four yards in his most recent appearance, which QB Drake Maye (lower leg) left early. With Tommy DeVito under center in Week 12, Douglas will try to get back on track in New England's banged-up passing game coming out of a bye week.

inj_report.short: Singletary finished with one carry for five yards and one catch for five yards in Sunday's 23-18 win over the Jaguars.
inj_report.long: The running back played just 10 offensive snaps behind starter Cam Skattebo. Singletary has averaged just 2.9 yards per carry this year on 41 attempts.

inj_report.short: Raymond caught three of his five targets for 20 yards during Chicago's win over the Lions on Thursday.
inj_report.long: Raymond had a solid outing against his former team, as he finished tied for fourth on the Bears in receptions. The 32-year-old has now caught 36 passes for 324 yards and a touchdown, in addition to racking up 209 punt-return yards across 11 games this season.

inj_report.short: Thomas could handle a larger role Sunday against the Titans, Demetrius Harvey of the Florida Times-Union reports that Parker Washington (shoulder) won't suit up.
inj_report.long: Thomas has had a disappointing third season in Jacksonville, mustering a meager 84 receiving yards over his last eight appearances while seemingly having fallen out of favor in coach Liam Coen's offense. Washington's absence against Tennessee's struggling secondary could provide Thomas with an opportunity to turn back the clock and turn in a performance reminiscent of the 2024 first-round pick's elite rookie season. Jakobi Meyers and Josh Cameron could also earn expanded roles in Jacksonville's wide-receiver room.

inj_report.short: Tucker caught two of 10 targets for 50 yards during Sunday's 38-24 loss to the Broncos.
inj_report.long: Tucker finished with a team-high 10 targets, but he was unable to get on the same page with quarterback Fernando Mendoza for the majority of the game. Most of the wide receiver's production came on a 39-yard catch in the fourth quarter, and he has now combined to reel in three of 12 targets for 59 yards over Mendoza's first two career starts.

inj_report.short: Kiner carried the ball 10 times for 25 yards in Sunday's 35-10 loss to Detroit.
inj_report.long: Rhamondre Stevenson was active despite dealing with a knee issue during the practice week, but the veteran back gained just four yards on six carries, and Kiner wound up leading the Patriots' backfield in both volume and yardage. The entire offense struggles after Drake Maye (ankle) was knocked out of the game early, however. New England gets a Week 11 bye, so Kiner's role and usage for a Week 12 clash with the Chargers likely won't become clear until the health of Stevenson and Maye come into focus after the break.

inj_report.short: Kincaid brought in both targets for 13 yards in the Bills' 13-10 loss to the Chiefs on Thursday.
inj_report.long: Making his return from a one-game absence due to thumb and ankle injuries, Kincaid's numbers weren't quite as poor within the context of a night where Josh Allen threw for only 81 yards and completed less than 50.0 percent of his passes. Kincaid tied for runner-up slotting on the Bills in receptions, and he was third in receiving yards as well. Kincaid now has multiple catches in five straight games heading into a Week 13 road divisional matchup against the Patriots on Sunday, Dec. 6.

inj_report.short: Bryant caught three passes for 32 yards on four targets in Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders.
inj_report.long: The wideout briefly exited the game in the third quarter after he appeared to tweak his previously injured ankle, but Bryant quickly returned and was able to finish out the contest. His four targets were fourth on the team on a day Bo Nix targeted nine different players on 35 pass attempts. The Denver offense spreads the ball around to five different receivers, three tight ends and its running backs most weeks, making it difficult for any of the pass catchers to post big numbers in the box score.

inj_report.short: Shakir brought in three of six targets for 33 yards in the Bills' 13-10 in over the Chiefs on Thursday.
inj_report.long: Shakir's reception and yardage totals led the Bills on a night when Josh Allen threw for just 81 yards with a pair of picks. The veteran slot receiver was coming off a Week 11 showing against the Dolphins in which he accrued a season-high 101 receiving yards, and Thursday's downturn was largely explainable by Allen's struggles and less-than-ideal weather conditions. Shakir should remain a key target for Allen during a Week 13 road matchup Sunday, Dec. 6 with a Patriots squad that the wideout posted a 7-82-0 line against back in Week 4.

inj_report.short: Felton is poised to maintain an expanded role Sunday against the Falcons, as Craig Peters of the Vikings' official site reports that Jordan Addison (thumb) will remain sidelined.
inj_report.long: Felton stepped up in Addison's absence during the Week 11 loss to San Francisco, leading the Vikings with 12 targets en route to six catches for 42 yards. Jauan Jennings and Myles Price are also candidates for additional targets from Kirk Cousins behind Justin Jefferson against a Falcons defense that gives up the fifth-most passing yards per game.

The wideout has now caught exactly one pass in three straight games and in five of his last six contests. Johnston is a lightly targeted deep threat who will likely continue to see fewer looks if Ladd McConkey is able to maintain his health for an extended period.

inj_report.short: Hill carried the ball six times for 69 yards and a touchdown and caught four of five targets for 27 yards in Sunday's 35-33 loss to the Panthers.
inj_report.long: Derrick Henry had a strong performance as well but was knocked out of the game in the fourth quarter and got checked for a concussion. Hill was heavily involved in the offense prior to that, however, scoring from 19 yards out in the late in the second quarter. He almost had a second TD earlier in the quarter, but Hill had the ball punched loose at the one-yard line after a 36-yard scamper and saw it bounce out of the end zone for a turnover and a touchback. Henry cleared the concussion protocol after the game and figures to be active in the Week 12 against the Texans, but Hill's usage appears to be on the upswing as the Ravens' No. 2 back.

Taylor's 25 yards were his most in a game since Week 7, and he's totaled just 10 catches for 75 yards and no touchdowns over his last four contests. He's a very risky play as a fantasy tight end.

The junior member of the Bears' backfield is up to five TDs on the season in six games, all on the ground, and Monangai's goal-line role keeps him fantasy-relevant heading into a Week 13 clash with the Jaguars.

inj_report.short: Parkinson caught both of his targets for minus-1 yard in a 26-13 victory over the Packers on Wednesday.
inj_report.long: Parkinson logged a hefty 83 percent offensive snap count, highest among Los Angeles tight ends. His two receptions also tied for the team lead among players at the position, but he couldn't do much with those catches, gaining just one yard on the first and losing two yards on the second. However, Parkinson could take on an even more important role moving forward, as Tyler Higbee (chest) and Davis Allen (ankle) both left Wednesday's win early and didn't return. If neither of those players is ready to suit up in Week 13 against Kansas City on Thursday, Dec. 3, Parkinson and untested rookie Max Klare would lead a tight-end corps that quarterback Matthew Stafford typically looks to often.

inj_report.short: Higgins caught his lone target for four yards during the Cardinals' 34-7 loss to the Chiefs on Sunday.
inj_report.long: The Cardinals offense struggled Sunday with Josh Johnson as the starter in the absence of Carson Beck (back). Of Johnson's 31 pass attempts, 26 of them were split between Trey McBride (14), Harrison Wallace (seven) and Simi Fehoko (five), leaving very little for Higgins and the other Cardinals pass catchers. Higgins has only one catch over his last two outings and a 19-166-1 line on 21 targets through 11 regular-season games.

inj_report.short: Harris caught both his targets for 28 yards in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets.
inj_report.long: With Ladd McConkey back in the lineup, Harris' role in the passing attack shrank after he'd turned 12 targets over the prior two games into an 8-92-0 line. Harris' fantasy appeal would collapse even further if Justin Herbert (concussion) ends up missing any time. The second-year wideout will at least get a promising matchup in Week 12 against a vulnerable Patriots secondary.

Considering he's surpassed 50 receiving yards just one time in 10 appearances in 2026, he doesn't hold much sway for fantasy purposes, especially in a Broncos offense that often has sputtered this season. Sutton's next chance to turn the tide arrives Friday at Pittsburgh.

inj_report.short: Allen caught one pass for minus-1 yard in the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Allen played 14 offensive snaps behind Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) and Chris Rodriguez, and Tuten ended up aggravating his ankle issue in the defeat. If Tuten needs to miss time, Allen could see elevated snaps behind Rodriguez, though Ameer Abdullah also is an option for the Jaguars out of the backfield. Ultimately, Allen is much likelier than not to remain irrelevant in fantasy.

inj_report.short: Metcalf won't receive a suspension after he was ejected from Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles, but the NFL is still reviewing discipline for the receiver that could include a fine, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
inj_report.long: Metcalf was disqualified with 4:53 remaining in the third quarter Sunday after he attempted to poke Eagles defensive back Cooper DeJean in the eye. He was flagged for unsportsmanlike conduct in what was his second major transgression of the game; Metcalf previously drew an unnecessary roughness penalty in the first half, when he held his block of DeJean well after a play had finished. Though Metcalf won't miss further game action as a result of his ejection, he may have already lost the faith of his fantasy managers heading into a Week 12 matchup with the Broncos on Friday. Metcalf has hauled in just 36 of his 74 targets (48.6 percent catch rate) and has scored just two touchdowns on the season while topping 60 receiving yards in only two of his 10 appearances.

inj_report.short: Ayomanor caught all three of his targets for 27 yards in Sunday's loss to Dallas.
inj_report.long: Ayomanor logged season highs with five catches, 10 targets and 79 yards against Jacksonville in Week 10, but he reverted back closer to his usual numbers versus the Cowboys. The second-year wideout did rank third on the team in receptions and receiving yards, and his 37 offensive snaps also were third behind Carnell Tate (62) and Chimere Dike (54). Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) is out for the remainder of the season, but Ayomanor may be hard-pressed to put up reliable fantasy production as the third pass-catching option, at best, for one of the league's least prolific air attacks.

inj_report.short: Ekeler turned seven carries into 41 yards and caught two of three targets for three yards during the Commanders' 22-20 win over the Bengals on Monday.
inj_report.long: Jacory Croskey-Merritt returned from a four-game absence due to a groin injury and finished Monday's game with 13 carries for 54 yards. Despite his return, Ekeler ended up with the second-most carries on the Commanders while Rachaad White -- who led Washington's backfield in Croskey-Merritt's absence -- didn't get a single touch on offense. It appears as though Ekeler is the preferred change-of-pace back in Washington's offense heading into Week 12 against Arizona.
