Rams head coach Sean McVay announced Monday that Grupe will miss the remainder of the season after sustaining a torn ACL in Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Cardinals, Greg Beacham of the Associated Press reports.

inj_report.short: Lutz made his lone field-goal attempt and all five PATs in Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders.
inj_report.long: The veteran kicker now has gone five straight games without missing a kick, as he's 9-for-9 on field goals and 14-for-14 on extra points in that span. With the Denver offense heating up after a slow start to the campaign, Lutz has become useful in fantasy. On the season, he's 17-for-20 on FGAs and has made all 21 of his PATs.

inj_report.short: Pineiro made all five of his PATs in Sunday night's 35-10 win over the Vikings.
inj_report.long: It was the veteran kicker's third game this season that he didn't attempt a field goal, but he's now gone three straight games with exactly five extra points. Pineiro now leads the league in both point-after attempts (40) and makes (36), but he's attempted just 11 field goals in a highly efficient San Francisco offense. The lack of field goals certainly keeps him from being a top fantasy kicker.

inj_report.short: Borregales made his sole field-goal attempt and one PAT in the Patriots' 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Borregales made a 33-yard field goal on the first drive of the game. The kicker is now 11-for-13 on field-goal attempts and 24-for-25 on PATs through 10 regular-season games in 2026.

inj_report.short: Slye made all three field-goal attempts and went 3-for-3 on PATs in Sunday's 51-30 loss to the Cowboys.
inj_report.long: The veteran kicker made field goals from 38, 48 and 28 yards in the first half and is in the midst of a career-best season. He's now 18-for-19 on field-goal tries and has made all 17 PATs through 10 games. Kicking in one of the lower-scoring offenses in the league, it still doesn't translate to much fantasy appeal for Slye ahead of next Sunday's road date with the Jaguars.

inj_report.short: Santos converted his only field-goal attempt and all four of his extra-point tries during Chicago's 39-35 win over the Detroit on Thursday.
inj_report.long: Santos' lone field goal came from 40 yards out during the victory. The 35-year-old has converted 18 of his 22 field-goal attempts and 33 of his 34 extra-point tries across 11 games this season.

inj_report.short: Bass went 4-for-5 on field-goal tries and made both of his PATs during Sunday's 26-9 win over the Dolphins.
inj_report.long: Bass was able to make at least three field goals for the fifth time in the team's last six contests. The kicker made field goals from 43 and 54 yards in the first half before adding makes from 40 and 28 yards in the fourth quarter. His lone miss of the day came in the third quarter, when he pulled a 54-yard try wide left, registering his first missed field-goal try of the year. Bass has now gone 24-for-25 on field-goal attempts, including 4-for-5 from 50-plus yards, over 10 contests so far during the 2026 campaign.

inj_report.short: Fairbairn made his sole field-goal attempt and all three PATs in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday night.
inj_report.long: Fairbairn's only field goal of the night was a 27-yarder with 15 seconds remaining in the first half. The kicker is 20-for-21 on field-goal attempts and 27-for-27 on PATs over 10 regular-season games so far in 2026.

inj_report.short: Myers missed his sole field-goal attempt and made three PATs in the Seahawks' 21-13 win over the Raiders on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Myers missed a 44-yard field-goal attempt with 7:05 remaining in the game that would have put the Seahawks up 14 points. The kicker is now 16-for-19 on field-goal attempts and 21-for-23 on PATs over 10 regular-season contests in 2026.

inj_report.short: Bates made both of his field-goal attempts and three of his four extra-point tries during Detroit's 39-35 loss to the Bears on Thursday.
inj_report.long: Bates' missed extra point came from 48 yards out due to a 15-yard taunting penalty. The 27-year-old has now converted 19 of his 21 field-goal attempts and 36 of his 37 extra-point tries across 11 games this season.

inj_report.short: Carlson reverted to the Dolphins' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.
inj_report.long: Carlson was signed to the Dolphins' practice squad this past Tuesday, two weeks after being released by the Saints. He served as the Dolphins' kicker Sunday against the Bills, when he made all three of his field-goal attempts in a 27-9 loss for Miami. The Dolphins do not have a kicker on the 53-man roster, so Carlson is almost certain to be elevated for Week 12 against the Jets on Nov. 29.

inj_report.short: McManus made all four of his field-goal tries and both of his point-after attempts Thursday in a 26-13 victory over Green Bay.
inj_report.long: McManus scored the first six points of the game with 43-yard and 41-yard field goals in the first quarter. He added a 40-yarder in the fourth and a 30-yarder just before the end of the game. The veteran kicker has yet to try a field goal from 50-plus yards, but he's been everything the Rams could have asked for since taking over as the team's kicker in Week 7. Through five games, McManus is a perfect 9-for-9 on FG attempts and 16-for-16 on PAT tries.

inj_report.short: Shrader went 1-for-3 on field-goal attempts during the Colts' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Thursday.
inj_report.long: Shrader opened Thursday's scoring with a 34-yard field goal early in the first quarter. Those ended up being the only three points scored by the Colts, as Shrader missed a 56-yarder later in the quarter, and his 62-yarder in the second quarter was blocked by Logan Hall. It was the second time this season that Shrader has missed two kicks, and the third-year kicker now is 24-for-28 on field-goal attempts (including 9-for-12 on kicks from 50-plus yards) and 19-for-20 on extra-point tries through 11 regular-season games. His scoring potential figures to be lower for the rest of the season after the Colts waived Daniel Jones on Friday, which paves the way for Anthony Richardson to start under center in Week 12 against the Giants on Sunday, Nov. 29.

inj_report.short: Patterson made his only field-goal attempt and went 4-for-4 on extra-point tries during Sunday's 35-33 loss to the Panthers.
inj_report.long: Patterson was able to convert his only field-goal try in Week 11, nailing a chip-shot 28-yard attempt in the first quarter. He's now combined to go 3-for-3 on field-goal attempts while making all six of his PATs over two contests as the starting kicker for Baltimore, and he likely will remain in that role for Week 12 with Tyler Loop (groin) sidelined for at least one more contest.
